items.title: 32.11 Kimiyai sanatein aur Pakistan ki maeeshat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.11, printed pages 238-239 (PDF 241-242).

blocks.text: Chemical industry Pakistan ki maeeshat (economy) ke liye bohat ahem hai: yeh mulk ki Gross Domestic Product (GDP, mulk mein saal bhar banne wali tamam cheezon aur khidmaat ki qeemat) mein bara hissa dalti hai aur rozgaar deti hai. Yeh doosre bare shobon ko sahara deti hai, jaise zaraat (fertilizers ke zariye), tameerat (cement ke zariye) aur kapra (textiles; dyes aur synthetic reshon ke zariye). Chemical industries mulk mein milne wala kaccha maal, jaise natural gas, rock salt, limestone aur crude oil, use kar ke ahem cheezein banati hain, jis se imports (bahar se mangwane) par inhisar kam hota hai.

Pakistan zarai (agrarian, kheti par chalne wali) maeeshat hai, is liye is ki food security chemical industry par munhasir hai. Maqami companies natural gas se urea banati hain, jis se mulk ka import bill arbon dollar kam hota hai. Pakistan ki exports (bahar bechi jaane wali cheezon) ka 50% se zyada hissa textiles ka hai. Yeh industry bohat zyada caustic soda (cotton ki mercerizing, yani dhaage ko mazboot aur chamakdar banane ke liye), synthetic dyes (rang aur rang ki pakhtagi ke liye) aur hydrogen peroxide (kapra safed karne, bleaching ke liye) istemal karti hai. Tameerati mansoobon (infrastructure projects) aur shehron ke phailao (urbanization) ki wajah se cement industry hamsaya ilaqon ko sab se zyada cement bechne walon mein shamil ho gayi hai.

blocks.prompt: Mulk mein natural gas se urea banana Pakistan ki maeeshat ki kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh zaraat aur food security ko sahara deta hai aur mulk ka import bill arbon dollar kam karta hai.

items: Chemical industry: GDP aur rozgaar; zaraat, tameerat aur textiles ko sahara.
Maqami urea se import bill kam; textiles 50% se zyada exports (caustic soda, dyes, H₂O₂).
Cement industry hamsaya ilaqon ko export karti hai.
